about_the_game:
Hi, I’m Christian Iacono, an 18-year-old Italian developer who created this game solo using Unreal Engine. I’m aware that some bugs might occur during gameplay, but I’ve worked hard to eliminate as many as possible. If you do encounter any issues, you can use the save/load option to bypass them.

That said, the most important thing is that you enjoy the game, the story, and the atmosphere.

Step inside The House — a place where every creak of the floorboards and flicker of the lights hides a clue… or a warning.
You awaken in an unfamiliar home, the doors locked, the windows sealed. To escape, you’ll need more than sharp eyes — you’ll need sharp wits.

Explore each room, search for hidden objects, and solve intricate puzzles that will test your logic and observation skills. Every corner tells part of the story, and every solved mystery brings you closer to the truth… and the exit.

Features:

  • Immersive first-person 3D escape room experience

  • Atmospheric visuals with realistic lighting and sound design

  • A mysterious narrative unfolding through clues and environments

  • Logical puzzles, hidden objects, and interactive exploration

  • Tense, cinematic moments that keep you on edge

Do you have what it takes to escape The House before it’s too late?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Playable at 1080p with low/medium settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700KF or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p/1440p with high/ultra settings

short_description: A first-person 3D escape room adventure where you explore themed rooms, uncover hidden clues, and solve logical puzzles. Use observation and reasoning to progress, with optional hints to guide you toward escape.
